context.transcript:
Hi, Marco.
Welcome to Shanik Associates.
We're delighted you're interning with us this summer.
Thanks.
I'm excited to get some practical experience in corporate law.
You'll learn a lot here, but things can move at a fast pace, so we're pairing you with a mentor.
Now, you've already filled out most of the paperwork.
I just need you to sign this last form, which allows us to get your employee badge made.
All right.
Here you go.
Thanks.
And here's your mentor, Hiroki, now.
Excellent timing.
We just finished up here.
Great.
Hi, Marco.
I hope your first day is off to a good start.
Let me take you to meet the rest of our team.
context.transcript_translation:
嗨，Marco。
欢迎来到 Shanik Associates。
我们很高兴您今年夏天能在我们这里实习。
谢谢。
我很高兴能在公司法律领域获得一些实践经验。
你在这里会学到很多东西，但事情可能会进展很快，所以我们会为你安排一位导师。
现在，你已经填完了大部分文件了。
我只需要您签署这份最后一份表格，这样我们才能为您制作员工徽章。
好的。
请看。
谢谢。
这是你的导师，Hiroki。
